assumptions: Canonical species templates, authoritative growth, equal earned budgets, identical seeds, swapped sides, deterministic accuracy, no consumables. Contact and approach seams are diagnostic only. Matrix seed7 is representative coverage, not a win-rate estimate. Observed DoT counts require scheduled ticks with visible HP loss, so simultaneous healing can make them a lower bound.
